changes: One communicate(payload) call in a dedicated non-daemon thread.
Main thread waits at most 50 ms per poll and preserves local/global checks.
Failure cleanup kills and reaps the child, joins the communication thread, then closes streams.
No private subprocess API, repeated input, verdict change, or trust change.
RuntimeError or OSError from only Thread.start becomes NormalWorkerError; caller check exceptions remain untouched.
limitation: The controlled worker must not leave descendants inheriting its standard pipes; this is direct-child cleanup, not portable process-tree isolation. The maintained worker creates no Python subprocesses. Standard-library APIs are portable, but this run tested Linux only.
